description: The states a task passes through after a cancel request, read with the driver op task_cancel_path (Rust: the lab's cancellation protocol oracle, the only place the path survives; C: its TASK_TRANSITION events). The lab runs a returning task's cleanup_done and finalize_done inside one step (lab/runtime.rs:4866-4890), so Finalizing has no step boundary and no trace event: the path is what tells a task that drained through it from one that skipped it. t.n and t.e acknowledge at a checkpoint that continues and return ok and err: cancellation wins over both, and each goes CancelRequested>Cancelling, Cancelling>Finalizing, Finalizing>CompletedCancelled. t.p acknowledges and panics: it goes Cancelling>CompletedPanicked, straight past Finalizing. t.u waits on a notify that nothing signals until t.m does, is cancelled while it waits, and has not acknowledged: its path is empty (read at 30) until the notify wakes it, and it then returns ok without a checkpoint, which cancellation still turns into Cancelled, so it goes CancelRequested>CompletedCancelled with no Cancelling and no Finalizing. t.f is never cancelled and has an empty path; t.h is cancelled only to give the entry at 110 a step in which the due timer of t.m fires. A read is applied before the step of its own entry, so each read of a completion comes one entry after the dispatch that made it (CANCEL-REQUEST, CANCEL-ACKNOWLEDGE, CANCEL-DRAIN, CANCEL-FINALIZE).
